svg.aria-label: In Claude Code, handoff-guard.mjs runs at each hook of a chat: it lists recent notes when a new chat starts, tells a handed-off chat to stop, and saves the recap as a note at each turn’s end so the next chat can take over.
svg.text: Claude Code: one chat, hook by hook

INSTALL, COMMANDS AND WHAT IT NEVER DOES
A dry run previews every change. --write copies the script into ~/.claude/,
merges the hook and status-line entries into settings.json, adds the recap
convention to CLAUDE.md, and backs up each file it changes.
